title_zh: 约定用具体教学贡献致谢导师

scenario.label_zh: 约定用具体教学贡献致谢导师
scenario.goal_zh: 核对导师对艺术家的影响，并约定用具体教学经历说明其贡献而不混淆作品作者

context_zh: 艺术家为个人展览撰写致谢文字，与策展人核对导师的贡献。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: You've called your teacher the inspiration for this exhibition. Did she suggest its subject?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Not the subject. She taught me to sketch the same street every day. That habit is her legacy in my work.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: So she was influential in how you observe, rather than in choosing these particular paintings?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Exactly. She was also instrumental in getting me my first shared studio, but the paintings and their themes are mine.

sentences.speaker: Imani
sentences.text: Then let's thank her for the daily sketching habit and the studio introduction. That's more precise than calling her a co-creator.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll write those two contributions into the acknowledgement.

targets.sense_zh: 带来创作灵感的人或事物
